_howto: Add or update an ad: copy an item, set spend (lifetime $), poster (image in assets/ads/), optional video (mp4 in assets/ads/), and optional case (a case-study page). The phone shows items with spend >= minSpend, biggest first; first: true puts one at the front. Then run build.py.
